All 25 source paragraphs are retained verbatim in contract.source_steps and mapped into the plan: R001/S001–S005 to T001–T004; R002 to T006–T007 with localization helper T005; R003 to T008–T009; R004 to T010–T013; R005 to T014–T016; R006 to T017–T019. The route retains complex weight separation only before reduction, matrix-unit preservation of the localized arbitrary lattice, equality of the coordinate modules, the rational dimension equation n=nr, minimum p-exponent principalization, natural scalar reduction and the nonzero-coordinate argument. It does not substitute a standard integer lattice or a different irreducibility proof. N001–N005 and complete P are all exported by the corresponding packages; there are no external E nodes. The supplied successful fragment type check is evidence of declaration elaboration only, not proof completion or mathematical fidelity.

parameters_and_allowed_inputs.notes: The complete P binds an arbitrary complex module V, natural p, integer lam, arbitrary field K, complex-linear x,y,h, the specified v, and an arbitrary integer submodule M. H001 is prime p together with exact characteristic p, not merely p=0 in K; H002 retains both integer inequalities. H003 retains finite dimension lam+1, all three correctly oriented operator commutators, existence of a highest vector and complex irreducibility. These are the operator presentation of the source sl2 action: the Chevalley relations extend the triple to that action, and invariant subspaces agree in both directions because the generators span. H004 concerns the actual supplied v over C. H005 quantifies a common integer/complex basis and stability under every divided power, equivalent to stability under the unital generated integer algebra; it neither specifies the minimal lattice nor assumes a basis of the form b e_i. Such a basis is derived later. Tracing implementation helpers across each source cut gives R001 only H002/H003/H004, R002 only its H001/H002/H003/H005/N001 boundary, R003 its H001/H002/N001/N002 boundary, R004 its listed preceding outputs and allowed library facts, R005 H001/H002/N001/N002/N004, and R006 H003/N005/H001/H002. T005 is derived from H001. T004, T007, T009, T013 and T016 supply the internal N packages; all conditional T inputs have preceding producers and disappear on assembly. LatticeOps existence is constructed in T006 and carried by T007/T016, not added as an original H. Neither algebraic closure, positive lam, odd p nor irreducibility over K is assumed. The domains include lam=0 and p=2 and are not made empty by the definitions.

representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Verified the P correspondence claim against the unfolded definitions in both directions. Under H002, Fin(lam.toNat+1) is precisely the source integer interval, includes both endpoints and is nonempty. Natural subtractions in matrix words and guarded lowering formulas stay in that interval; extendFamily supplies the required terminal zeros. Admissible represents the actual arbitrary subgroup as an integer submodule, an equivalent encoding for additive subgroups of V. R is not silently identified with Q: T005 explicitly requires the exact fraction carrier equivalence and fraction-field property. In the pinned library, liftBaseChange sends s tensor m to s times f(m), so iota and qmul are the actual multiplication maps; Ji is the preimage under c maps to c e_i. T006 proves iota injective before image identification, T009 gives the exact finite coordinate-sum isomorphism, and T010–T013 prove rational rank one and principalization rather than assume them from J being contained in C. Principal means a nonzero b with J=span_R{b}, which entails b belongs to J and is equivalent to J=Rb. VK uses the commuting tensor factors K tensor_Z M consistently; swapping factors is an invertible identification intertwining the induced actions, with no second implementation representation left to connect. Pinned ModN G p is G modulo the range of integer multiplication by p and has the canonical ZMod p-module structure. TensorMaps installs precisely kappa.toAlgebra and the characteristic-induced ZMod algebra, requires actual K-linear equivalences, pure-tensor equations and operator naturality; T014 must construct these, including inverses. ReducedBasis records the image of the same R-basis under phi. Every field of LatticeOps is an integer-linear endomorphism of M and Agrees fixes each value, including all divided powers, so agreeing restrictions are unique and source preservation constructs them. Target therefore states precisely nonzero VK and the universal zero/top alternative for its actual induced x,y,h. Conversely those source restrictions supply its existential witness. Generator invariance is equivalent to invariance under the source Chevalley Lie algebra's K-span also in characteristic two.

statements_and_local_plans.notes: Unfolded every local statement and compared all complete T signatures with their listed inputs and source paragraphs. Coordinates includes the integer dimension/count, all lowering identities, nonzero e_i, an actual complex Basis, termination and all natural divided-power indices with integral binomial coefficients. LocalLattice plus MatrixIdentities includes rank, full span, preservation of M and its localized image, all three edge identities, binomial units and every matrix-unit identity. Pinned Module.End multiplication is composition with the right factor acting first; Basis.coord and smulRight give exactly E_ij(e_k)=delta_jk e_i. CommonModule contains nonzero finite J and the specified coordinate isomorphism. RationalLine and PrincipalLattice retain injectivity, rational span, finite rational dimension one, principal-generator existence and the basis conclusion for every such generator. ScalarReduction, ReducedBasis and ReducedUnits retain both natural tensor isomorphisms and naturality, the basis's origin, dimension lam+1, all generator endpoints, all factorials through lam, all relevant nonzero binomials, divided-power/power identities and the matrix-word delta action. The universal delta clause for any generator-formula basis applies to the same beta exported by ReducedBasis; all indices in its word are at most lam, so no unjustified factorial inverse is used. T016 explicitly must establish these conclusions by reducing the original matrix-unit identity. T017 uses powers, scalars and composition to preserve W; T018 uses a single compatible nonzero vector and coordinate and obtains nontriviality from the nonempty basis; T019 constructs Target from the existing agreeing restrictions. Simple is explicitly Nontrivial plus the universal invariant-subspace assertion, not an opaque name for an assumed result. No missing producer, hidden conclusion in a construction field, unsupported change of scalar field, or vacuous basis guard was found. The obligations remain to be proved and assembled; this judgment accepts their semantic interface and source-guided plans, not local Lean bodies or final kernel closure.
